Linda Gustafsson once led a high-stakes migration of NordicTech’s legacy systems to Kubernetes, resolving a 90% downtime issue during peak seasons. She orchestrated a phased rollout using ArgoCD, paired with Prometheus/Grafana for real-time monitoring, which slashed incident resolution time by 40% and stabilized SLA compliance. Her ability to balance technical rigor with team collaboration was evident in how she mentored junior engineers through the chaos of the transition.  

Linda is a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at NordicTech, where she architecturally oversees cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. She designs CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, ensuring deployments meet 99.95% uptime targets. Her expertise in cloud cost optimization, achieved through Terraform-driven resource tagging and VPC subnet restructuring, reduced monthly spend by 30% without compromising performance. She also champions Linux administration best practices, embedding Ansible into automation workflows that cut manual tasks by 50%.  

Beyond technical mastery, Linda excels in systemic problem-solving. Her chaos engineering initiatives, which simulated real-world outages, uncovered critical vulnerabilities in the network stack. She also pioneered a monitoring framework integrating ELK for log analysis, enabling proactive issue detection. Her work ethic is marked by relentless attention to detail and a knack for turning complex challenges into streamlined processes.  

Linda’s contributions are indispensable. Her technical depth, strategic thinking, and collaborative spirit make her a rare asset in any enterprise setting. I wholeheartedly endorse her for any role requiring both operational excellence and innovative leadership.
